title: Now Follows the Episode of Kullu

blocks.text: Banda wants to see Kullu and its sacred heights, but once he enters the region he is seized and confined by the local ruler.
The text insists that such confinement cannot truly hold him, yet the first dramatic image is unmistakable: Banda in an iron cage, surrounded by anxious Sikhs and emboldened enemies.
The iron cage transforms the Kullu episode into a test of humiliation, endurance, and supernatural reversal.
